name: Record picker
description: A tag field whose chips are records picked from a list: one person to assign, many labels to apply. Type to filter, Enter picks the active record, Backspace in the empty field removes the last, and a create row turns new text into a record.

classes.ayy-record-picker: Root: an ayy-tag-input and ayy-combobox holding the chips, the input, the clear button and the listbox.
classes.ayy-record-picker--multiple: Several records: chips wrap, and the list stays open after each pick (aria-multiselectable).
classes.ayy-record-picker__tag: One picked record, an .ayy-chip--removable.ayy-tag-input__tag <span data-value> with a named .ayy-chip__remove button; the label shrinks so the × stays inside.
classes.ayy-record-picker__tag-label: The record's name inside a chip: it shrinks and ellipsises when the name is longer than the field, instead of pushing the × out.
classes.ayy-record-picker__input: The borderless <input role="combobox"> after the chips; the field's id, label and aria-describedby go on it.
classes.ayy-record-picker__clear: The icon button after the input that clears every chip, named by aria-label ("Clear"); hidden while nothing is picked.
classes.ayy-record-picker__listbox: The .ayy-combobox__listbox: records, the create row and the empty row. At least as wide as the field; at most 24rem unless the field is wider.
classes.ayy-record-picker__option: One record, an .ayy-combobox__option[role="option"] with data-value, data-label and data-keywords. Active: data-active="true"; picked: aria-selected="true" and a check.
classes.ayy-record-picker__option-body: The two lines after the icon: name and description. Takes the row's leftover width.
classes.ayy-record-picker__option-label: The record's name, one line with an ellipsis.
classes.ayy-record-picker__description: The muted second line (an email, a role, a key), one line with an ellipsis.
classes.ayy-record-picker__create: The last option: "Create “Maya”" when creatable, the query isn't empty and no record matches exactly.
classes.ayy-record-picker__create-label: The create row's text, written by the controller from createLabel.
classes.ayy-record-picker__empty: The muted, centred row when nothing matches ("No people").

default.looks: A Tag input wash field with the picked records as chips, a text box and the clear button; list closed.

hover.when: .ayy-record-picker__clear:hover (hover devices) and a list option under the pointer
hover.looks: The clear button gets a --ayy-color-wash-hover circle; an option gets Combobox's wash-hover.

pressed.none: No pressed look; the picked chip is the feedback.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring on the clear button, Tag input's ring around the field; each chip's × has its own.

disabled.when: disabled on the input and on the chips' × and clear buttons
disabled.looks: Tag input dims the field to --ayy-opacity-disabled; the buttons dim too.

selected.looks: A check at the inline end, never colour alone. Picking it again removes it in multiple mode and replaces it in single.

error.looks: Tag input's destructive border and focus ring; say why in a FieldError.

loading.none: No loading look. With manual, show a Spinner or a "Searching…" row and call refresh().

open.looks: The listbox opens under the field. Once there's a query the first match is active and aria-activedescendant points at it; a focused or clicked field opens the full list with no row active.

scale.sm: Tag input's sm: at least --ayy-size-control-sm, sm text.
scale.md: Tag input's md: at least --ayy-size-control-md (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch).
scale.lg: Tag input's lg: at least --ayy-size-control-lg, more padding, lg text.

sizes.density: The field and chips follow data-density through Tag input; the clear button is as tall as the field's inner height, so the field keeps its size token.
sizes.width: Fills its container; chips wrap in multiple mode. The listbox is at least the field's width, and no wider than 24rem unless the field is wider.

js: recordPickerClass({ multiple?, size?, className? }) → root classes; recordPickerChip(option, removeLabel?) → a chip with its × button; recordPickerClearIcon (SVG markup); defaultCreateLabel(label) → "Create “Maya”"; connectRecordPicker(root, { multiple?, creatable?, filter?, createLabel?, onSelect?, onCreate?, onRemoveLast?, onClear? }) → { open, close, refresh, destroy } wires plain markup (filtering, the active row, the create row, Escape, Backspace, clear and focus) and copies the input's aria-labelledby or aria-label onto an unnamed listbox. It never changes chips or aria-selected.

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-record-picker and makes it work in plain HTML: it draws the chips, keeps aria-selected, one hidden input per picked id when name is set, and fires ayy-change. A created record gets a slug id and a chip; the app replaces the id from ayy-create. refresh() re-reads options a manual search replaced.
element.children: An .ayy-record-picker with the picked records' chips, its input, the clear button and the .ayy-record-picker__listbox of .ayy-record-picker__option rows.

attributes.multiple: Pick several records; the list stays open after each pick.
attributes.creatable: Offer a create row for the typed text when no record matches.
attributes.manual: Don't filter: replace the options yourself (a search API), then call refresh().
attributes.name: Form name: a hidden input per picked id carries it.

events.ayy-change: { ids, options: [{ id, label }] } — after every pick, removal and clear.
events.ayy-create: { id, label } — when the create row is picked; the chip already exists. Replace the slug id with the saved record's id.

RecordPicker.renders: <div class="ayy-record-picker ayy-tag-input ayy-combobox"> chips + <input role="combobox"> + clear button + <ul class="ayy-combobox__listbox">; other props go on the input, className on the root

props.options: RecordPickerOption[] — id, label, description?, icon?, keywords?, disabled?
props.value / defaultValue: string[] — the picked ids; value makes it controlled
props.multiple: boolean — several records; the list stays open
props.onCreate: (label) => RecordPickerOption | void — return the new option to select it, or update options and value yourself
props.createLabel: (label) => string — the create row's text. Default "Create “<label>”"
props.emptyText: ReactNode — when nothing matches. Default "No matches"
props.name: string — a hidden input per picked id
props.clearable: boolean — show the clear button. Default true

a11y: Label the input with <Label htmlFor> and aria-labelledby (or aria-label); the controller copies that name onto the listbox, so the list reads as "Assignee".
The input keeps focus: arrows move aria-activedescendant, Enter picks, Escape closes and clears the query, and the pointer never moves focus into the list.
In multiple mode the list is aria-multiselectable: picked records carry aria-selected and a check, and picking one again removes it.
Each chip's × is named "Remove Ada Lovelace", and Backspace in the empty field removes the last chip.
do: Use it to attach records to something: an assignee, labels, projects, reviewers.
Give options a description when names repeat, and keywords for what people type (an email, a project key).
Turn on creatable only when a new record is allowed, and save it in onCreate so its id is the real one.
dont: Don't use it for free text — use a Tag input for tags or recipients, or an Input for one value.
Don't use it for a short known list — use a Select, a Segmented control or a Combobox.
Don't rely on colour for picked rows; keep the check.
